3605-3734-4808-5131.description:
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Phyrexian Metamorph by paying {3}{U/P}, causing it to enter as an artifact copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Dance of the Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from the graveyard to the battlefield tapped with Dance of the Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

requires.n: One-drop creature with a second body

1957-4050-7918--204.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the one-drop creature, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, it and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the creature's ability, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Sifa Grent ability, gaining at least one life and causing at least one opponent to lose at least one life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the one-drop creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token creature, adding one colored mana.
Cast the creature by paying one mana.
Repeat.

225-851-4365-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

215-3291-7060.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 6.
215-3291-7060.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Karametra's Acolyte from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Karametra's Acolyte by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

277-774-1671.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it and Tiller Engine each trigger.
Resolve Tiller Engine's ability, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Simic Growth Chamber's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
277-774-1671.notes: After gaining an arbitrarily large amount of mana, you may repeat the loop choosing Tiller Engine's other mode to tap any number of nonland permanents opponents control.

2034-7182-7252.description:
Cast Grave Sifter for its evoke cost by paying {4}.
When Grave Sifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Grave Sifter, adding {C}{C}.
When Grave Sifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Grave Sifter with haste.
When the Grave Sifter token enters, it triggers, returning Grave Sifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the remaining Grave Sifter ability from step 2, doing nothing.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Grave Sifter token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1475-2034-7084.notablePrerequisites: You control another nonland creature with power 1 or greater that does not have One with the Kami attached to it.
1475-2034-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control with power 1 or greater.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and One with the Kami trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the land's power.
Repeat.

2653-2893-4500-6763.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Retreat to Kazandu trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Retreat to Kazandu trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

826-1246-4275.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's first ability by tapping it, causing any creature an opponent controls to gain all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Spirit Mirror by paying {0}, destroying the opponent's creature.
When the creature dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping Amoeboid Changeling.
Repeat.
826-1246-4275.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

4067-6281-6927-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
4067-6281-6927-7013.description:
Activate White Lotus Tile by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Damage Control Crew.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Damage Control Crew that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Damage Control Crew token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Damage Control Crew from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping White Lotus Tile.
Repeat.

141-997-2562.description:
Cast Graceful Reprieve by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Graceful Reprieve, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Graceful Reprieve.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, Graceful Reprieve triggers, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Woe Strider abilities from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with five or more charge counters on it

132-198-5090.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on it.
Activate Myr Welder by paying {6}, untapping it.
Repeat.
132-198-5090.notes: You can start the combo with fewer charge counters on Myr Welder but will need additional mana to compensate.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2457-4289-6791.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2043-2713-4715-6753.description:
Activate Urza by paying {4}, creating two token copies of Prized Statue that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
When the Prized Statue tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

1563-1753-2457-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

38-659-3499.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of Goblins that is equal to or greater than six plus Krenko's commander tax.
38-659-3499.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Goblin creature tokens equal to the number of Goblins you control.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Krenko, adding {R}.
Choose to return Krenko to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Krenko.
Cast Krenko from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{R} plus commander tax.
Repeat.

1235-2743-6570.description:
Cast Mnemonic Deluge by paying {6}{U}{U}{U}, exiling Twinflame and casting three copies of it without paying their mana costs.
Resolve the three Twinflame copies, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

1018-1987-3617-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1018-1987-3617-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Skullwinder.
When Skullwinder and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Walk from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk during your draw step.
Repeat.

1115-2034-3372-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
1115-2034-3372-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {C}{C}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

141-997-3645.description:
Cast Black Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{B}
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Black Sun's Twilight.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Black Sun's Twilight
Resolve the Black Sun's Twilight copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1409-4050-4112-5725.easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Sharuum the Hegemon.
1409-4050-4112-5725.description:
Activate Sharuum the Hegemon by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Sharuum the Hegemon enters the battlefield, it, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Monkey Cage trigger.
Resolve the Sharuum the Hegemon trigger, returning any artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Sharuum the Hegemon.
Resolve the Monkey Cage trigger, causing you to sacrifice it and create six 2/2 Ape creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Apes, adding {2}{U}{U}.
Activate Sharuum the Hegemon by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Sharuum the Hegemon enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Sharuum the Hegemon trigger, returning Monkey Cage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Sharuum the Hegemon.
Repeat.

643-1358-1636.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
Maskwood Nexus does not have summoning sickness.
643-1358-1636.description:
Activate Sydri's first ability by paying {U}, causing Maskwood Nexus to become a 4/4 artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate any number of mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Maskwood Nexus by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a 2/2 Shapeshifter creature token.
When the Shapeshifter enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {4}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1283-1496-4078-4242-5147.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1283-1496-4078-4242-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Su-Chi.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Chainer by paying {3} and 3 life, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Su-Chi enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Su-Chi's toughness.
Repeat.

122-1545-1734-5147.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability and Trostani.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Fiend Hunter's toughness.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Phyrexian Delver until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Phyrexian Delver from exile to the battlefield.
Phyrexian Delver enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Trostani.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Phyrexian Delver's toughness.
Resolve the Phyrexian Delver trigger, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose three life.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Goblin Bombardment abilities, dealing infinite damage to any target(s).

927-3104.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Jon Irenicus triggers, giving control of Sea Serpent to an opponent who controls no Islands.
When Sea Serpent's controller controls no Islands, Sea Serpent triggers, causing them to sacrifice it.
However, Sea Serpent cannot be sacrificed due to its ability.
Sea Serpent triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

708-2019-2034-3771.notablePrerequisites: You are able to cast The Prismatic Piper for {0} due to Animar and Myth Unbound.
708-2019-2034-3771.description:
Cast The Prismatic Piper from the command zone by paying {0}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing The Prismatic Piper, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to have The Prismatic Piper return to the command zone.
Myth Unbound triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

776-1329-2709-4671.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Mechanics do not have summoning sickness.
776-1329-2709-4671.description:
Tap Orcish Mechanics, sacrificing Accorder's Shield to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Accorder's Shield.
Cast Accorder's Shield.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
